arm-sling.notes: the look's kit draws the sling as part 'sling'

ash.notes: die, then the parts dissolve upward as ash (or toward the target for consumed)

cheer.notes: both arms up in a V

clap.notes: the hands meet in front of the body

dance.notes: a bouncing two-step, one hand high and the other low, then swapping

draw.notes: moves the weapon from back or belt to hand_front at pass

draw-bow.notes: takes an arrow from the back socket's quiver

draw-crossbow.notes: takes an arrow from the back socket's quiver

frozen.notes: holds whatever pose the actor is in, stops the blink, tints violet; the runtime doesn't blend out of the last pose

idle.notes: breathing twice and easing the weight across and back, the feet planted

interact.notes: using what's in front: a door, a lever, a counter, a chest (the art guide's Interact cycle)

jog.notes: The party's pace: an upright, steady jog, a short flight between steps, the elbows bent near

jump.notes: straight up and down where they stand

look-back.notes: the head's parts flip to look behind; hair_back moves across to the other side

run.notes: A cutscene's run: a longer flight, a deeper lean, the knees and arms driving harder.

slide-to.notes: pulled toward the cue's target; the runtime moves the root there

turn.notes: the runtime flips facing at the halfway point, where the figure is squashed thinnest

walk.notes: A relaxed walk for strolling townsfolk: heel to toe, the planted leg near straight, the arms

wave.notes: the near hand up beside the head, the forearm waving
